# Dev Prabha Foundation (DPF)

> Dev Prabha Foundation is a registered Public Charitable Trust (NGO) in Sugauli, East Champaran, Bihar, India, working across Healthcare, Education, Livelihood, and Community Partnerships (HELP).

## Key Organization Facts
- **Full Name**: Dev Prabha Foundation (also known as DevPrabha Foundation / DPF)
- **Legal Status**: Public Charitable Trust (Non-Government Organization)
- **Registration Number**: 2034/2017 (Registered on 04/03/2017)
- **NITI Aayog Darpan ID**: BR/2018/0207803
- **Section 12A Registration**: CIT(E)/Pat/12AA/04(341)/2018-19/1616-20
- **Section 80G Tax Exemption**: CIT(E)/Pat/80G/11(31)/18-19/2861-65 (50% income tax relief for donors)
- **Headquarters**: Bangra, Sugauli, East Champaran, Bihar - 845456, India
- **Geographic Focus**: Sugauli, East Champaran, West Champaran, North Bihar, and rural India
- **Official Website**: https://dpf.org.in
- **Primary Email**: info@dpf.org.in
- **Secondary Email**: kbt@dpf.org.in
- **Helpline Phone**: +91 9480259311
- **Bank**: Punjab National Bank, Sugauli, East Champaran, Bihar

## Core Pillars (H.E.L.P.)
1. **Healthcare**: Free Sanjeevani mobile medical camps, pediatric & geriatric checkups, free medicines, eye checkups & eyeglasses distribution, and building a 200-bed Multispecialty Hospital in Sugauli, Bihar.
2. **Education**: Village study centers, girl-child school retention programs, textbooks, and digital literacy tutoring for students in grades 1–10.
3. **Livelihood**: Rural women Self-Help Groups (SHGs), tailoring & computer vocational training, and organic agro-entrepreneurship.
4. **Partnership**: Grassroots community collaboration, disaster relief, and 0%-fee direct donor transparency.

- [Donate](https://dpf.org.in/donate): Direct 0%-fee bank/UPI donations with instant Section 80G e-receipt generation.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO)
- **How do donors get an 80G tax receipt?** Donations made via direct transfer with UTR/Reference number and PAN generate an instant official downloadable e-receipt under Section 80G(5).
- **Why does Dev Prabha Foundation use direct bank/UPI transfers?** Direct transfers avoid 2%–3% payment gateway fees so 100% of every rupee reaches rural healthcare and education beneficiaries.
- **Where is the 200-bed hospital being built?** In Sugauli, East Champaran, Bihar, to provide affordable ICU, emergency, maternity, and surgical care to North Bihar families.
